notes.title: San Fernando in The Storyteller's Festival 2024
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that we will be participating in this year's #TheStorytellersFestival!

Huge thanks to Two and a Half Studios for allowing us to be part of this amazing selection of VNs & narrative games✨

notes.title: San Fernando is part of the Game Devs of Color Gradient Convergence 2023
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that we are a part of this year’s #GDoCExpo! 🎮

The Game Devs of Color Expo showcases games by creators of color, paving the way to a better game industry.
